description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5306011361741 BOLT,CLOSE TOLERANC: Line 0001 Qty 621 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0204 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
